name: Copywriter
tagline: Turns a ranked story into slide-by-slide carousel copy and a caption
description: The writing stage of a Portuguese-language Instagram line. It picks up whatever the research bot marked as worth publishing and shapes it for a carousel: one block of text per slide, held in reading order, plus the caption that sits beneath the finished post. The words then move on to the design stage as a brief.
author: adamuchigabriel
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
